# CourtFile

Canonical: https://dasgroupllc.com/apps/courtfile/
Product: https://courtfile.dasgroupllc.com/
Provider: Das Group LLC (https://dasgroupllc.com/)
Last updated: 2026-08-18
Also known as: CourtFile court filing review software, litigation matter brief software

## What is it?
CourtFile is court filing review software that turns court filings into a verified matter brief with deadlines, parties, claims, timelines, and source-linked summaries. The workflow is built for teams that need to understand an active matter quickly before a hearing, deadline, or handoff.

Short answer: CourtFile answers "what matters in this filing packet?" with source-linked deadlines, parties, claims, and procedural context.

## Who is it for?
- Litigation paralegals
- Associates inheriting an active matter
- Litigation support teams
- Litigation operations leads

## What problem does it solve?
It reduces the time spent reconstructing deadlines, parties, claims, and missing records from large filing packets, and keeps every key fact tied to the underlying filing page for fast confirmation.

## What does it produce?
- Matter overview and filing inventory
- Party and counsel extraction
- Procedural timeline
- Live claims and motion summaries
- Upcoming deadlines with source references
- Key rulings and citation links
- Missing document and verification notes

## What documents can it handle?
Complaints, answers, motions, oppositions, replies, orders, notices, docket sheets, declarations, exhibits, and related filing packets.

## Does it replace attorney judgment?
No. CourtFile reduces manual reconstruction and makes the record easier to review; it does not replace attorney analysis.

## How is it different from generic AI chat?
CourtFile is organized around a structured, source-linked matter brief instead of an unverified chat answer. Every deadline, claim, and party stays tied to the filing page it came from.

## API & Developer Tools
MCP Server Endpoint: https://courtfile.dasgroupllc.com/sse

The CourtFile MCP (Model Context Protocol) server provides programmatic access to:
- Court e-filing requirements by jurisdiction
- Filing fee estimation (court fees + service fees)
- Document format requirements (PDF specifications, bookmarks, etc.)
- Supported e-filing systems: Tyler Odyssey, File & ServeXpress, NYSCEF, eFiling Portal, CM/ECF

Available MCP tools:
- list_courts — List all supported US courts, filterable by state
- lookup_court — Get detailed court info including accepted filing types
- estimate_filing_fee — Calculate total filing costs
- get_filing_requirements — Get document format and procedural requirements

## FAQ
Q: What is CourtFile?
A: Court filing review software that turns filings into a verified matter brief with deadlines, claims, parties, and source-linked summaries.

Q: Can CourtFile extract deadlines from court orders?
A: Yes. Deadline extraction from court orders, notices, and motion papers is a core use case, with each deadline linked to its source page.

Q: What is a verified matter brief?
A: A structured summary of the matter that keeps key facts tied to the underlying filing pages for fast confirmation.

Q: How do I start?
A: Join the waitlist at https://courtfile.dasgroupllc.com/waitlist to evaluate the workflow.
